content: 16 KB page size: Android 15 supports 16 KB devices; Google Play requires apps targeting Android 15+ submitted/updated after 1 Nov 2025 to support 16 KB. Native .so must be ELF-aligned (-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384); NDK r28+ defaults to 16 KB. Older prebuilt binaries (e.g., retired ffmpeg-kit, old ML Kit 16.1.7) crash with UnsatisfiedLinkError/dlopen failure on 16 KB devices.
